behavior.shared_message: Path is not allowed or does not exist
behavior.target_resolution_order: Normalize lexically; resolve only trusted configured roots; check configured/canonical prefixes; resolve eligible target; check canonical containment.
behavior.outside_target_lookup: Unit test verifies no toRealPath/getFileSystem call on a lexically denied target.
behavior.error_details: Shared validation message omits rejected target and underlying filesystem exception cause.
behavior.symlinks: Existing, dangling and looping escapes denied; configured root aliases and allowed in-root aliases supported.
behavior.outside_aliases: Arbitrary aliases outside every configured/canonical root denied even if they point inward.
behavior.administrator_token_root_selection: Administrator-chosen root aliases still resolve to canonical directories; global containment enforced before grant issuance.
behavior.browser: Same generic errorMsg for all tested rejected targets.
behavior.legacy_session_basic: Same generic 400 invalid_request status/payload for rejected paths.
behavior.v1_session: Generic 400 invalid_request; envelope timestamp varies normally.
behavior.restricted_bearer: Uniform generic 403 forbidden for missing, global-root, symlink and token-root denials; envelope timestamp varies normally.
behavior.rejected_jobs: No scan job created by tested denials; mocked execution receives no denied work.
behavior.pinned_paths: Canonical authorization handoff and queued PATH/WATCH revalidation from #21 retained.
behavior.daemon_exclusions: Global path containment precedes submitted-spelling and canonical daemon exclusion checks.

verification_limits.integration_execution: Path privacy MVC integration uses actual authentication/path/job services and H2, with ScanExecutionService mocked to verify rejection before queueing.
verification_limits.packaged_execution: Real JAR/Tomcat/H2/files and synthetic ClamD wire replies; explicit loopback trusted proxy headers for Basic/Bearer HTTPS checks.
verification_limits.browser_ui: Server-rendered operator HTML checked through MockMvc and real HTTP. No new headless browser interaction run for #24.
verification_limits.docker_native_engine_external_services: No new Docker, native engine, live LDAP/OIDC or external SQL deployment run. Earlier scoped reports are retained.
verification_limits.filesystem_mutation: This change does not provide filesystem snapshot isolation. Existing execution-time redirect checks remain active.
verification_limits.response_comparison: Compares public errors/statuses, excluding the v1 timestamp and unrelated changing browser/CSRF content.
verification_limits.api_compatibility: Restricted Bearer missing-path submissions now return 403 instead of 400. Arbitrary outside aliases are no longer valid scan input.
